```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(knitr)

library(purrr)
options(survfit.rmean = "common")

data_raw <- read.csv("C:/Users/ETay/Documents/Work documents/CIRCA DIEM/Data/short_term_outcome_data_v0.8.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, header = TRUE)


data <- data_raw %>%
  mutate(rand_gp = case_when(study_id == "CD-04011" ~ 1, .default = rand_gp),
         rand_gp = case_when(rand_gp == 2 ~ 0, .default = rand_gp),
         nonrand_gp = case_when(nonrand_gp == 2 ~ 0, .default = nonrand_gp),
         rand_gp = factor(rand_gp, levels = c ("0","1"), labels = c("Control", "Intervention")),
         nonrand_gp = factor(nonrand_gp, levels = c ("0","1"), labels = c("Control", "Intervention")),
         date_42wpma = as.Date(date_36wpma) + weeks(6),
         date_44wpma = as.Date(date_36wpma) + weeks(8),
         date_52wpma = as.Date(date_36wpma) + weeks(16),
         )
levels(data$rand_gp) <- c("Control", "Intervention")
#
#NI - if had ROP Grade 1 - can't have ROP+ # confirm with Gill and Jane
# older than 30 weeks - ROP+ = 0
# CD-06007  ROP - unk, ROP+ - UNK, ROPRX - UNK
# if rop.factor = 0 and rop_plus_yn = unk then rop_plus_yn1. = 0

# participant with rop = NI CD04044 passed away
# particianpt with ROP ~ 5 are > 30 weeks therefore can't have ROP by definition
# participant with roprx = 99 or NI had no ROP - NI
#flag for September - similar process for NEC - have 0 necdx but have Stage 1 NEC (suspected)
#cd-02042 = nectage = 1, cd-04050 = necstage = 1
#CD-06002 = necstage = 2
#mutate(necstage1 = case_when(necdx == "0" ~ "0", necdx == "NI" ~ "0", necstage == "NI" ~ "0", .default = necstage)) %>%

#some multiples aren't really multiples


#only include rand_sib for data_elig
data_elig <- data %>%
  filter(rand_sib == 1)

data_sib <- data %>%
  filter(rand_sib == 0)


```


## CONSORT ROWS - Randomised

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r , echo=FALSE}
 
 exclude_1 <- data_elig %>%
 mutate(wd_1 = case_when(withdraw_yn == 1 & (as.Date(withdraw_dt) < as.Date(date_36wpma)) ~ 1, .default = 0),
        dth_1 = case_when(dth_yn == 1 & (as.Date(dth_dtm) < as.Date(date_36wpma)) ~ 1, .default = 0),
        LKA_1 = case_when(is.na(death_36wpma) & dth_yn != 1 & withdraw_yn != 1 ~ 1, .default = 0))
        #LTFU_1 = case_when)
        


sum(exclude_1$dth_1)
table(exclude_1$rand_gp, exclude_1$dth_1 == 1)
sum(exclude_1$wd_1)
table(exclude_1$rand_gp, exclude_1$wd_1 == 1)
sum(exclude_1$LKA_1) #LTFU - 36mth cPNA < date extracted
table(exclude_1$rand_gp, exclude_1$LKA_1 == 1)

        
data_36 <- exclude_1 %>%
 filter(!(wd_1 == 1 | dth_1 == 1 | LKA_1 == 1))
nrow(data_36)#680

table(data_36$rand_gp)
    # Control Intervention 
    #      354          326 
table(data_36$rand_gp, data_36$ga_strata)

 exclude_2 <- data_36 %>%
 mutate(wd_2 = case_when(withdraw_yn == 1 & (as.Date(withdraw_dt)) < date_42wpma ~ 1, .default = 0),
        dth_2 = case_when(dth_yn == 1 & (as.Date(dth_dtm)) < date_42wpma ~ 1, .default = 0),
        LKA_2 = case_when(is.na(death_42wpma) & dth_yn != 1 & withdraw_yn != 1 ~ 1, .default = 0))
 

sum(exclude_2$dth_2)
table(exclude_2$rand_gp, exclude_2$dth_2 == 1)
sum(exclude_2$wd_2)
table(exclude_2$rand_gp, exclude_2$wd_2 == 1)
sum(exclude_2$LKA_2) #this includes the LTFU in the exclude boxes
table(exclude_2$rand_gp, exclude_2$LKA_2 == 1)
        
data_42 <- exclude_2 %>%
filter(!(wd_2 == 1 | dth_2 == 1 | LKA_2 == 1))
nrow(data_42) #540

table(data_42$rand_gp)
     # Control Intervention 
     #     282          258 
table(data_42$rand_gp, data_42$ga_strata)

exclude_3 <- data_42 %>%
 mutate(wd_3 = case_when(withdraw_yn == 1 & (as.Date(withdraw_dt)) < date_44wpma ~ 1, .default = 0),
        dth_3 = case_when(dth_yn == 1 & (as.Date(dth_dtm)) < date_44wpma ~ 1, .default = 0),
        LKA_3 = case_when(is.na(death_44wpma) & dth_yn != 1 & withdraw_yn != 1 ~ 1, .default = 0))


sum(exclude_3$dth_3)
table(exclude_3$rand_gp, exclude_3$dth_3 == 1)
sum(exclude_3$wd_3)
table(exclude_3$rand_gp, exclude_3$wd_3 == 1)
sum(exclude_3$LKA_3) #this includes the LTFU in the exclude boxes
table(exclude_3$rand_gp, exclude_3$LKA_3 == 1)

data_44 <- exclude_3 %>%
  filter(!(wd_3 == 1 | dth_3 == 1 | LKA_3 == 1))
 nrow(data_44)#530
 
table(data_44$rand_gp)
 # Control Intervention 
 #         278          252 
table(data_44$rand_gp, data_44$ga_strata)

exclude_4 <- data_44 %>%
 mutate(wd_4 = case_when(withdraw_yn == 1 & (as.Date(withdraw_dt)) < date_52wpma ~ 1, .default = 0),
        dth_4 = case_when(dth_yn == 1 & (as.Date(dth_dtm)) < date_52wpma ~ 1, .default = 0),
        LKA_4 = case_when(is.na(death_52wpma) & dth_yn != 1 & withdraw_yn != 1 ~ 1, .default = 0))    


sum(exclude_4$dth_4)
table(exclude_4$rand_gp, exclude_4$dth_4 == 1)

sum(exclude_4$LKA_4) #this includes the LTFU in the exclude boxes

data_52 <- exclude_4 %>%
filter(!(wd_4 == 1 | dth_4 == 1 | LKA_4 == 1))
nrow(data_52) #515

table(data_52$rand_gp)
    # Control Intervention 
    #      267          248
```
